jobs.title: Consumer Data Product Manager - PVH Corp.
jobs.description:
About Us:

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.

One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at PVH here .

About the Role:
As a Data Product Manager, you will play a key role in supporting PVH’s Data Powerhouse initiative, a strategic effort to modernize, unify, and scale data capabilities across the enterprise. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, data engineering, and analytics, you will help develop and manage governed, high-value data products that drive business insights, operational efficiency, and innovation.

You will be responsible for executing a roadmap for scalable data products, ensuring they align with enterprise objectives and empower data-driven decision-making across commercial, consumer, and supply chain functions. Working closely with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Business Intelligence, and business units, you will translate business needs into actionable data solutions while ensuring compliance with governance, security, and quality standards.

A key part of your role will be enhancing data product adoption and discoverability within PVH’s Data Marketplace, ensuring data products are trusted, well-documented, and easily accessible. By driving collaboration across teams, promoting best practices, and enabling self-service analytics, you will contribute to the success of PVH’s data transformation and help maximize the value of enterprise data assets.

What You will Do:
- Define and manage a portfolio of data products, ensuring they align with business objectives and deliver measurable value.

- Key driver in establishing reporting and analytics strategies and capabilities in global CDP transformation.

- Develop and execute a product roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.

- Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business teams to deliver high-quality data products.

- Oversee the product lifecycle, from ideation and development to deployment and continuous improvement.

- Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics to assess the impact and effectiveness of data products.

- Advocate for data governance, data quality, and security best practices to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.

- Collaborate with engineering teams to develop scalable and cost-effective data solutions.

- Support user adoption and training to promote self-service analytics and data-driven decision-making.

- Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance data product capabilities.

What You will Bring:
- 5-7+ years of experience in data product management, analytics, or a related field.

- Functional knowledge of Retail, Supply Chain, or Consumer domains, with an understanding of industry-specific data challenges and opportunities.

- Proven ability to manage and deliver data products in an enterprise environment.

- Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, preferably AWS, Databricks, and Power BI.

- Understanding of data governance, data engineering, and data architecture principles.

- Experience in Agile product development methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration.

- Strong analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making and business impact.

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.

- Strong knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data visualization techniques.

- Familiarity with data governance tools such as Collibra and data platforms like Databricks and Power BI.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience in managing product roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and agile development workflows

Preferred
- Experience working with AI and machine learning-driven data products.

- Certifications in Agile Product Management, AWS, or related fields.

- Background in the retail industry or other data-intensive sectors.

This role is not eligible for sponsorship.
This role requires to be onsite 4 days Monday through Thursday. Friday can be WFH flex day.

#LI-BC10

Pay Range:$125,100---$169,300

PVH currently provides base salary ranges for all positions-on job advertisements-in the United States based on local requirements. These ranges are based on what PVH reasonably believes that it will pay an associate for their base salary for said position at the time of the posting. Individual compensation will ultimately be determined based on a variety of relevant factors including but-not limited to qualifications, geographic location and other relevant skills. PVH is committed to providing a market-competitive total rewards package to eligible associates, which includes diverse and robust health and insurance benefits to meet the varied needs of our associates and an above-market 401(k) contribution to help our associates save for retirement. We also offer career growth opportunities, empowering our associates to design their future at PVH.

Additional Compensation: This role is bonus eligible.

Your Wellbeing is Our Priority

At PVH, we offer competitive, cost-effective, and comprehensive benefit packages. We strive to provide options when it comes to your health, finances, and work-life balance. This includes:
- Pay & Insurance: Competitive pay, bonus programs, best in class medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and more.

- 401(k): An above-market 401(k) contribution to help our eligible associates save for retirement.

- Flexible Workplace: Generous company-paid holidays, paid time off, hybrid working arrangements, volunteer opportunities, seasonal hours, and flexible work schedules.

- Wellbeing Support: A variety of wellbeing tools and programs such as, Headspace membership, reimbursement for fitness memberships and/or digital meditation subscriptions, and the opportunity to earn up to $200 a year in rewards for exercising and participating in healthy activities.

- Care.com Services: Access to services for childcare, elder care, adoption preparation, pet care, plus reimbursement for backup care when your regular plans fall through.

- Education Assistance: Receive support for continued education including tuition reimbursement.

- Associate Discount: Shop at our company outlets and e-commerce sites at a discount.

Please note, eligibility depends on employment status, location and length of time employed with PVH and our benefits may be subject to change. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.

To achieve these goals, across the United States and its territories, PVH prohibits any PVH employee, agent or representative from requesting or otherwise considering any job applicant’s current or prior wages, salary or other compensation information in connection with the hiring process. jobs.title: Senior Director Product Strategy - Tommy Hilfiger Global
jobs.description:
Be part of an iconic story.

TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world’s most recognized global lifestyle brands, confidently welcoming and inspiring consumers since 1985. Originally established in New York City and infused with the vibrant spirit of Americana, to create the modern uniform of accessible luxury. The TOMMY HILFIGER brands consist of TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS, complemented by a range of licensed product categories that extend the brand lifestyle across generations, geographies, activities and occasions. Tommy Hilfiger’s global marketing approach and communications strategy taps into culture through the world of F.A.M.E.S.: the people, organizations and ideas boldly driving the future of Fashion, Art, Music, Entertainment and Sport. Major global campaigns, sponsorship platforms, and disruptive activations with world-class athletes, musicians and entertainers bring a constant source of energy and inspiration to the brand. Immerse yourself in TOMMY HILFIGER here! ( YouTube , Instagram , TikTok )

About the Team
The Product Strategy team defines the long-term and seasonal direction of the Tommy Hilfiger global Product organization. We connect consumer, market, commercial and financial insights to the strategic choices that drive sustainable growth, accelerate category performance and strengthen the global product proposition.

Working closely with Global Product Leadership, Merchandising, Planning, Regional Commercial teams, Marketing, Consumer Brand Experience and other cross-functional partners, the team develops multi-season product strategies, seasonal strategic direction and company priorities. The team also provides executive decision support and leads strategic planning, governance and high-impact initiatives that advance the Product organization’s contribution to PVH’s strategy.

About the Role
As Senior Director, Product Strategy, you lead the Product Strategy function and help shape the strategic agenda for the Tommy Hilfiger Product organization. In partnership with the Product Leadership Team, you translate company and brand priorities into a clear multi-season product direction, enabling better strategic choices, accelerated category growth and a stronger global product proposition.

You oversee a diverse portfolio spanning long-term product strategy, category acceleration, seasonal direction and selected company-wide strategic initiatives. As a trusted advisor to the Chief Product Officer and Product Leadership Team, you ensure consumer, commercial, competitive and financial insights are translated into clear priorities, investment recommendations and measurable business outcomes.

Leading through a Director and senior strategy professionals, you integrate portfolio priorities, establish governance and operating rhythms, and ensure the team delivers high-quality, decision-ready work with sustainable organizational impact.

This role reports to the Vice President, Product Strategy & Operations.

Key Responsibilities
Including but not limited to;
- Define and evolve the long-term Product Strategy agenda, translating company and brand priorities, consumer insights, market and competitive trends, and commercial opportunities into clear product choices and growth priorities.
- Shape the Product organization’s category acceleration agenda, connecting long-term opportunities with seasonal priorities, investment choices and measurable business outcomes.
- Lead the strategic direction for seasonal planning, ensuring multi-season ambition is translated into actionable seasonal frameworks, category priorities and decision guardrails.
- Integrate priorities, sequencing and resource choices across the Product Strategy portfolio, recommending which work is accelerated, deferred, reduced in scope or stopped; balance long-term strategic value, commercial impact, urgency, dependencies, organizational capability and available capacity, and communicate the implications of those choices clearly.
- Own and evolve the Product Strategy operating model, including portfolio ownership, planning cadence, governance, decision rights, performance measures and strategic reporting; use insights to redirect attention and resources.
- Lead selected strategic initiatives and transformation priorities, ensuring clear objectives, robust analysis, aligned ownership, effective execution and measurable outcomes, and that related initiatives reinforce rather than compete with one another.
- Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the Product Leadership Team, overseeing executive-ready insights, recommendations and strategic narratives that support critical business decisions.
- Represent and champion Product priorities in company-wide and cross-functional forums, ensuring strategic decisions translate into aligned execution across functions and regions.
- Build trusted partnerships across functions and regions, constructively challenge assumptions, navigate complex trade-offs and influence senior stakeholders toward aligned strategic outcomes.
- Support the Product Leadership Team on selected high-priority executive priorities, leadership forums and special strategic projects as business needs evolve.
- Lead the Product Strategy function through a Director and senior strategy professionals, setting clear objectives, portfolio ownership and decision rights; delegate accountability at the appropriate level and oversee performance, delivery quality and sustainable workload, and enable the team to shape outcomes through cross-functional influence.
- Build organizational capability through resource and workforce planning, coaching, performance management and succession; recommend investment priorities and oversee the deployment of approved resources so the team has the capacity and capabilities to deliver the strategic portfolio sustainably.

The ideal candidate
Experience
•  Typically brings 12+ years of progressive experience in product strategy, business or brand strategy, strategic planning, business transformation, management consulting or a related discipline, including at least 7 years of managerial experience leading senior professionals and leaders within complex global organizations.
•  Experience within the apparel, footwear, retail or broader consumer goods industry is strongly preferred; experience gained within a leading global strategy or management consulting firm is considered a strong advantage.
•  Proven experience defining and leading long-term product, category, portfolio or brand strategies and multi-year strategic planning that drive sustainable business growth, category acceleration or enterprise transformation.
•  Significant people-leadership experience, including setting portfolio ownership, managing performance, building leadership capability and developing succession across a senior professional team.

Skills
•  Strong commercial, consumer and product acumen, with the ability to integrate market, competitive, operational and financial insights into clear strategic recommendations, priorities and resource choices.
•  Proven ability to integrate multiple strategic portfolios, establish effective governance and performance oversight, and lead execution through senior professionals rather than retaining recurring ownership of delegable analysis or deliverables.
•  Strong executive communication and influencing capability, with the ability to simplify complex topics, develop compelling strategic narratives, constructively challenge assumptions and negotiate critical choices with senior leaders.
•  Demonstrates sound judgment and organizational leadership through major change, creating clarity from ambiguity, aligning senior stakeholders around evolving priorities, and balancing strategic ambition, business value, dependencies, organizational capability and sustainable delivery while accepting accountability for difficult sequencing and prioritization decisions.
•  Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to challenge and guide sophisticated analysis, financial modelling and executive storytelling produced by the team.
•  Fluent in written and spoken English, with the ability to influence and build alignment across functions, regions and leadership levels.

Education
•  Holds a Master’s degree in Business, Strategy, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline, or the equivalent in relevant experience; an MBA is preferred.

Your Wellbeing is Our Priority

In the heart of Amsterdam, PVH is home to the global headquarters of Tommy Hilfiger and the European offices of Calvin Klein.
- Wellbeing:  exclusive onsite gym and fitness classes, personal training, meditation studio, sports clubs, in-house physio, and receive access to our nutritional and wellbeing programs

- Campus:  extensive food and beverage offerings, top-notch restaurant, barista coffee bars, sky bar, monthly social events, weekly Thursday drinks, game nights, and campus-themed activities that will keep your social life busy

- Develop your career: whether you lead a team or contribute your own expertise, everyone is a leader at PVH. PVH University curates and delivers training programs for you to continuously develop your professional and personal goals

- Be at the forefront:  stay closely connected to our brands, CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, and be a part of seasonal market launches, sample sales and receive employee discounts!

Check out our Amsterdam Campus here.

jobs.title: End to End Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us:

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.

One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at PVH here .

Position Overview
The End-to-End Product Data Analyst is responsible for supporting the quality, integrity, and operational readiness of product and article master data across PVH's global technology landscape. As part of the Global SAP-ERP Team, this IT role partners with Product Creation, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to ensure product and article data is complete, accurate, and ready to support end-to-end business processes.
This role serves as PVH's technical and functional expert for product and article data, including article structures, style-color-size relationships, GTIN management, product hierarchies, and enterprise data flows across SAP, PLM, MDM, PIM, and downstream applications. The role supports global transformation initiatives, validates product data readiness, analyzes complex data issues, and drives continuous improvement to reduce downstream business process failures.
This position is based in Bangalore, India, and partners with global business and IT teams across North America, Europe, and Asia.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Article Data Management
- Serve as the IT subject matter expert for enterprise product and article master data.
- Analyze and support product data including styles, colors, sizes, SKUs/articles,  product hierarchies, attributes, and business associations.
- Ensure product and article data is complete, accurate, and validated before supporting downstream business processes.
- Maintain a deep understanding of PVH's product and article structures, numbering conventions, business rules, and end-to-end data flows.

Product Data Quality & Readiness
- Perform detailed analysis of product and article data across SAP, PLM, MDM, PIM, and related enterprise applications.
- Identify missing or incorrect product data before it impacts planning, sourcing, procurement, distribution, retail, wholesale.
- Validate article creation, GTIN assignments, size relationships, and product hierarchy structures.
- Support the identification, validation, and publication of golden product data.

Global Deployments & Solution Delivery
- Support product and article data activities for global ERP projects
- Validate product data mappings, conversions, interfaces, and deployment readiness.
- Support mock conversions, cutover activities, and post-deployment validation.
- Develop and execute end-to-end product data testing scenarios covering multiple business processes and data variations.

Business & Technology Partnership
- Partner with Product Creation, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Supply Chain, PLM, MDM, PIM, SAP, and Integration teams to resolve product data issues.
- Provide guidance on SAP product and article data requirements, business rules, and downstream system impacts.
- Support global projects by ensuring product data changes are evaluated for their impact across the end-to-end technology landscape.
- Partner with the Enterprise Data Governance team to support enterprise data standards and quality initiatives.

Continuous Improvement
- Analyze recurring product and article data issues and drive root cause resolution.
- Develop documentation, validation procedures, and best practices for enterprise product data.
- Identify opportunities to automate product data validation and improve operational efficiency.
- Develop reporting and metrics to monitor product data quality and readiness across the enterprise.

Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience supporting product or article master data within retail, apparel, fashion, or consumer products.
- Strong experience with SAP product master data and enterprise applications including PLM, MDM, and PIM.
- Deep understanding of apparel product structures including styles, colors, sizes, SKUs/articles, GTINs, attributes, and product hierarchies.
- Experience supporting ERP projects, master data migrations, or global deployment initiatives.
- Strong understanding of end-to-end product data flows from Product Creation through Planning, Sourcing, Distribution, and Sales.
- Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with strong Microsoft Excel proficiency.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across global business and IT teams.
- Bachelor's degree required.

Key Competencies
- Product & Article Master Data
- SAP Material Master
- Article Management
- Style, Color & Size Structures
- GTIN Management
- Product Hierarchies
- PLM, MDM & PIM
- Data Quality & Validation
- Global Deployments
- End-to-End Business Processes
- Root Cause Analysis
